desc.ian_image_library:title: Abandoned shrimp nets
desc.ian_image_library:descr: White fish lay in brown murky water nearby an abandoned shrimp net. In Chilika Lake, active shrimp pens and abandoned nets trap sediment and kill juvenile fish.
